name: Coniophora puteana

branch_angle.note: midpoint of the reported range of mean branching angles, 1.22 to 1.56 rad (70 to 89 deg), from image analysis of strain MUCL 11662 (BAM 15) growing over a bare Petri dish from a malt agar plug, 15 to 30 C and 65 to 80% RH
branch_angle.source: De Ligne L, Vidal-Diez de Ulzurrun G, Baetens JM, Van den Bulcke J, Van Acker J, De Baets B 2019, Analysis of spatio-temporal fungal growth dynamics under different environmental conditions, IMA Fungus 10:7

t_opt.note: this paper reports, from Schmidt et al. 2002 (Z. Mykologie 68:141-152, not opened), an optimum of 22.5 C for 7 of 15 isolates and 25 C for 8; 24 is the midpoint. The paper's own optimum for growth over a dry inert surface was 20 C at 75% RH, with little growth at 30 C; it lists other reported optima from 20 to 32 C
t_opt.source: De Ligne L, Vidal-Diez de Ulzurrun G, Baetens JM, Van den Bulcke J, Van Acker J, De Baets B 2019, Analysis of spatio-temporal fungal growth dynamics under different environmental conditions, IMA Fungus 10:7

notes: Reported (unchecked) to form fine dark strands, to be wetter and more heat-tolerant than Serpula lacrymans, to be a standard brown-rot test fungus and to have a sequenced genome. It pumps water into dry wood, lifting it above fibre saturation within days (research/06 [38]).
